column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “into heaps of ruins” is rendered “in ruins.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Your faithful ones” is rendered “Your godly ones.”
Close to the Hebrew; the singular “it has devoured” is rendered “they have devoured.”
“Former iniquities” is rendered “the iniquities of our forefathers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “atone for” is rendered “forgive.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Your arm” is rendered “Your power,” and “leave over the sons of death” as “preserve those who are doomed to die.”
